title: Sehaj
description: Sehaj is designed around ease, where movement feels natural and uninterrupted. Planned for elderly users, the home avoids a clinical approach, focusing instead on intuitive living. Wider doorways, gentle slopes, and a barrier-free layout allow seamless circulation, while open planning enhances continuity.
details: The bathroom follows the same logic, with anti-skid flooring, grab bars, a seating ledge, and accessible fixtures supporting safety and independence. Soft, neutral materials create a calm environment without excess. Rather than adding elements, Sehaj removes friction shaping a home that quietly supports everyday life with dignity, comfort, and simplicity.
